verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own REST API and my.anydesk portal can list active sessions and online devices, close an active session, and remove a client from the license. Together these cover seeing current connections, disconnecting, and revoking a device. However, all of this evidence is account- or console-level administration, not an on-host view or control as the story specifies. missing for 10: documented host-side display of currently connected users, host-side disconnect/revoke controls, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
